notes.title: DEMO | Patch #2 «Echoes of the Sands»
notes.content:
[b][u]Patch #2 «Echoes of the Sands»[/u]
Greetings, explorers! We’re thrilled to unveil Patch #2, bringing new features, enhanced visuals, and a host of fixes. Dive into your adventure with renewed vigor![/b]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b][u]Visual Markers for Key Items[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Now, significant objects gleam with highlights in your field of view, making them easier to spot from afar. Explore the world with greater ease![/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Knowledge Tags in Inventory[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Items holding quest-critical knowledge are now marked in your inventory. Don’t miss a single clue![/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Additional Graphics Settings[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Customize ray quality, smoke, and more to your liking. Enhanced DLSS options and FSR 2 support ensure smoother, stunning visuals.[/i]
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png[/img]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[b][u]Revamped Hieroglyph Mini-Game[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]The heroine now places translated hieroglyph stickers into the text herself, making the process intuitive and engaging.[/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Updated Tutorial[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]We’ve reworked some tutorial sections and added a new inventory segment tied to the journal, helping newcomers settle in faster.[/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Enhanced Item Interaction[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]The interaction button now appears only when hovering over an item in range—no more accidental clicks![/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Fixed Water Surfacing[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Oxygen now restores correctly when surfacing vertically. Dives are more reliable than ever![/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png[/img]  
[h3]Visual Enhancements[/h3]
[b][u]Reworked Character Skin Material[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Skin now scatters light from sources more accurately, delivering a more lifelike and vibrant look.[/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Overall Optimization[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]We’ve boosted game performance, ensuring your sandy adventures run even smoother.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png[/img]  
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[b][u]Minor Map Adjustments[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Small landscape and object imperfections have been smoothed out.[/i]
[/list]
[b][u]General Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]A slew of minor bugs— from wonky textures to random crashes—has been banished to oblivion.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: DEMO | Patch #1 «Echoes of the Sands»
notes.content:
[b]In this update, we have made many improvements and fixes to the demo version to make your game acquaintance even more exciting.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288955/c6aeecdabf6eb6a69d597e065d5d520142bfa71b.png[/img]
[h3][u]List of major changes:[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Engine update: the game has switched to updated version of the engine and updated to Unity 6
[*] Added a map (guide) with main and additional tasks.
[*] Added additional tips for quests, making it easier to complete.
[*] The location light has been worked out, including the underwater zone.
[*] Some tasks have been reworked.
[*] Corrected the text.
[*] The panel with hieroglyphs in the dictionary has been enlarged when deciphering hieroglyphs for convenience.
[*] Removed a bug with stickers in the mini-game for deciphering hieroglyphs.
[*] Fixed some bugs with icons.
[*] Fixed some animations.
[*] Improved optimization.
[*] Fixed minor bugs in the interface related to the display and interaction of elements.
[*] Added new sounds.
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]
